scraped_replies.html:
Is the STHV1600 supported by ST anymore? I have a design using this part and I could really use some assistance. I know I am probably not going to get anywhere in the 'community' because the data is under NDA.

I opened a support ticket and received the reply below:

 

Thank you for reaching out to us with your request. Unfortunately, we're unable to fulfill this request at this time but are happy to give you some options to explore to get your answer.

 

Provided below are a couple of links that may further assist you with your question.

The community:https://community.st.com/

Partner Program:https://www.st.com/content/st_com/en/partner/partner-program.html?country=country

 

You will find great responses, take time to post here.
scraped_replies.author: ALE4

scraped_replies.html:
Welcome @ALE4, to the community!

Support for the STHV1600 is still being provided, but it is subject to an NDA and is supplied exclusively by the local authorised distributor or directly. The community is a worldwide public forum, so information subject to an NDA may not be shared here.

Please contact either your local distributor or the contact with whom you communicated at the time (in your case ticket# 00221565).

Good luck!

Regards
/Peter
